long_biography.plain_text:
An Amsterdam apartment was the starting point for Arnoud Litjens’s Short Stay Group in 2005. The Dutch entrepreneur developed a business around furnished, short-term stays as the city’s licensing regime changed. By the early 2010s the operator had entered several European cities and built its own property-management software. Litjens was its owner, while professional managers directed daily expansion.

The company then concentrated on Amsterdam, Paris and Barcelona and introduced YAYS as an aparthotel brand. Litjens remained an active shareholder through that phase. Investment firm Proprium acquired YAYS in 2017. The group later became part of Numa, which bought it from Proprium.
